title: Item:Experience Elixir
wikitext:
__NOTOC__ {{Top}} Consuming an experience elixir grants your character a percentage bonus on all earned experience for the next 3 to 6 hours that you are logged in and in a quest. The effect timer pauses while you are in public areas. The bonus of experience elixirs doesn't apply to XP tokens won with [[Daily Dice]]. You can drink multiple potions in succession. The effects don't stack, but they are queued.
